# Yakolak Copilot Instructions

Always read and follow root `AGENTS.md` before proposing, editing, or reviewing code.

For AI-team tasks also read `ops/ai-team/TEAM_OS.md`, the named worker task file, and current `ops/ai-team/BOARD.md` locks. Treat task scope, effort, change budget, validation ladder, independent review, and human release gates as mandatory.

Prioritize real game playability, online correctness, released regression safety, desktop/mobile evidence, and native runtime state. Do not create parallel contracts, fake native states, broad rewrites, hidden fallbacks, or weakened tests.
